# ANTIMICROBIALS FOR PATIENTS UNDERGOING PROCEDURES THAT INVOLVE INFECTED SKIN,
## SKIN STRUCTURES, OR INFECTED MUSCULOSKELETAL TISSUE TO PREVENT ENDOCARDITIS OR PROSTHETIC JOINT INFECTION
## Inpatient

## Pathogen unknown or possibly MSSA or beta-hemolytic streptococcus
Dicloxacillin 500 mg PO 1 hour before procedure ($) [DI]
< OR >
## Patients unable to take oral medications
## Suspected MRSA
Trimethoprim/Sulfamethoxazole 1 DS table PO 1 hour before incision
($) [R,DI]
< OR >
Minocycline 100 mg PO 1 hour before incision ($) [DI]
< OR >
## Outpatient

## Pathogen unknown or possibly MSSA or beta-hemolytic streptococcus
Cephalexin 2 gm PO 1 hour before procedure ($) [R]
## Suspected MRSA
Trimethoprim/Sulfamethoxazole 1 DS table PO 1 hour before incision
($) [R,DI]
< OR >
Minocycline 100 mg PO 1 hour before incision ($) [DI]
## _______________________________________________________________________________

*Local guidance (Des Moines CDSS, Inpatient):*
Cephalexin 2 gm PO 1 hour before procedure ($) [R]
Cefazolin 1 gm IV over 20 minutes, beginning 60 minutes before incision ($) [R]
[Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV over 60 minutes, beginning 120 minutes before incision](surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)
($) [R]
